data.one_liner: A responsive bottom navigation bar with automatic scaling for screen sizes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a responsive bottom navigation bar widget that automatically scales text size, icon size, and button padding depending on the screen size. It supports gradients, borders, background blur, and custom button spacing.
use_when: You need a responsive bottom navigation bar for a multi-platform Flutter app.
You want automatic scaling of text, icons, and padding based on screen size.
avoid_when: Your app uses a Flutter version older than 3.47.
You need a navigation drawer or a standard top navigation mechanism instead of a bottom bar.
strengths: Very easy to set up and beginner friendly.
Provides responsive sizing by default for text and icons.
Offers rich customization like gradients, borders, and blurred background.
weaknesses: Requires maintaining the selected state manually via your app's state.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.47 or newer and the material_ui dependency.
